cd /workdir && cat > play.py <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys,chess,time
count=int(sys.argv[1]);secs=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '90'
for _ in range(count):
    out=subprocess.check_output(['python3','arena.py','show'],text=True)
    if 'Your move.' not in out:
        print(out,flush=True);break
    fen=re.search(r'^FEN: (.+)$',out,re.M).group(1)
    moves=re.search(r'^Moves: (.+)$',out,re.M).group(1)
    board=chess.Board(fen)
    analysis=subprocess.check_output(['./think',fen,secs,moves],text=True)
    move=re.search(r'bestmove (\S+)',analysis).group(1)
    print('Move',board.fullmove_number,analysis.splitlines()[-2:],flush=True)
    with open('analysis.log','a') as f:f.write(fen+'\n'+analysis+'\n')
    assert chess.Move.from_uci(move) in board.legal_moves
    result=subprocess.check_output(['python3','arena.py','move',move],text=True)
    print(result,flush=True)
    if 'Your move.' not in result:break
PY
